ratings_why.fun: One clock dial that Eggs, sleepers and hour engines each want set differently gives a real placement and Wind decision every turn, and cards like Sleeping-Vault Warden cross into other tribes' boards.
ratings_why.distinct: Over a 7 because no tribe today builds the timing of the fight itself, and planting your units inside the enemy's line-up to hit their back row plays unlike any auto-battler tribe I know.

verdict_why: The core is strong; a few overlaps between sleep and Chicks need a written rule before players can read them.

points.text: Sleeping-Vault Warden next to a Seven-Sleeper or Old Unruh gives two wake hours; say which one wins (the later one keeps the sleeper's plan alive).
Say whether a Chick on the enemy's side counts as your awake unit (for sleepers waking at once) and as a friendly unit dying (for Old Unruh). Both change what the board does.
If Chick deaths do feed Old Unruh, that is the best bridge between the Egg and sleeper builds: Kasimir's front-row Chicks die in the enemy's rows and Unruh wakes huge. Worth listing as a build.
A Warden-slept Tower Doorkeeper doubling hours while untouchable is the tribe's best hidden combo; a sleeper that also gets doubled by Jar-Fattener rewards building the Vault around the Doorkeeper.
Seven-Sleeper fights Ottilie and Wind directly; a version that grows from the hours it slept through (rather than only never waking) would let it join the fast clock instead of only the slow one.

standouts.why: Puts any unit to sleep with its text working: guards a Hedgerow engine, a Fairy or your own Doorkeeper. Use outside its purpose built in.
Little Gernegroß copies the enemy's biggest unit inside their own line-up, and with Wechselbalg and Midsummer Leaver it becomes a permanent theft.
Frau Wechselbalg makes every opponent a different puzzle: a Cleave Chick in their back row, a Shield Chick stealing their defence.

weakest.why: Day-Wage Journeyman is a plain gold payout with no combo hook beyond counting hours.
Bench Dozer is a sturdy body that sleeps one hour; it does one obvious job.
Egg-Painter is a flat counter tick each turn with no decision attached.

flags.note: Midsummer Leaver with Little Gernegroß banks a copy of the enemy's biggest unit permanently on every win; strong against the lobby leader and worth a sim.
Two Asleep durations on one unit have no rule; also 'the unit to the right' at the end of a row.
Whether an enemy-side Chick counts as your awake or friendly unit is not written.
